name: sandbox-sdk
description: Application-owned sandbox patterns and workspace file operations for Cloudflare Containers

scripts.check: vp pack && vp check && npm run knip && npm run shim:check
scripts.example:workspace:deploy: npm run shim:build && npx --yes wrangler@4.131.2 deploy --config examples/workspace/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.example:artifact-workspace:deploy: npm run shim:build && npx --yes wrangler@4.131.2 deploy --config examples/artifact-workspace/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.example:checkpoint-workspace:deploy: npm run shim:build && npx --yes wrangler@4.131.2 deploy --config examples/checkpoint-workspace/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.example:preview-workspace:deploy: npm run shim:build && npx --yes wrangler@4.131.2 deploy --config examples/preview-workspace/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.example:process-workspace:deploy: npm run shim:build && npx --yes wrangler@4.131.2 deploy --config examples/process-workspace/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.example:coding-agents:pi:deploy: npm run shim:build && npx --yes wrangler@4.131.2 deploy --config examples/coding-agents/pi/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.example:coding-agents:claude-code:deploy: npm run shim:build && npx --yes wrangler@4.131.2 deploy --config examples/coding-agents/claude-code/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.example:coding-agents:codex:deploy: npm run shim:build && npx --yes wrangler@4.131.2 deploy --config examples/coding-agents/codex/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.example:coding-agents:opencode:deploy: npm run shim:build && npx --yes wrangler@4.131.2 deploy --config examples/coding-agents/opencode/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.shim:build: docker build --platform linux/amd64 --target image --tag sandbox-tools:local --file images/sandbox-tools/Dockerfile .
scripts.test:package: vp pack && vp test --run packages/sandbox/tests/packed-api.test.ts && npm pack --workspace packages/sandbox --dry-run
scripts.test:release: npm test && npm run test:package && npm run test:s3-e2e && npm run test:s3-lifecycle
